source_text: Nam pergebamus in Numidiam simul, ut semper antea, socio parique comitatu ingressi uiam, quae nos ad exoptatum fidei ac religionis obsequium, illos iam ducebat ad caelum. Et ueneramus ad locum qui appellatur Muguas, cui est Cirtensis coloniae suburbana uicinitas, in qua tunc maxime ciuitate gentilium caeco furore et officiis militaribus persecutionis impetus quasi fluctus saeculi tumescebant, et auidis faucibus ad tentandam iustorum fidem rabies diaboli infestantis inhiabat. Unde Marianus et Iacobus beatissimi martyres certissime exoptata diuinae in se dignationis signa tenuerunt, qui in ea regione, in qua persecutionis tempestas turbulentius fureret, hora iam maturante deducti intellegebant sua Christo gubernante ad ipsum coronae locum directa uestigia. Namque omnes dilectos dei cruenti et caecati praesidis furor per militares manus infensis et infestantibus animis requirebat. Nec in hos solos crudelitatis exercebatur insania, qui superioribus persecutionibus inconcussi libere deo uiuerent, sed in illos quoque manum diabolus insatiabilem porrigebat, quos iamdudum in exilia submotos, etsi nondum sanguine, mente iam martyras, ferox praesidis amentia coronarat.
pass_a_gloss: For we were proceeding into Numidia at the same time, as always before, having entered the way with an allied and equal company, which way was conducting us to the desired service of faith and religion, and them already to heaven. And we had come to a place named Muguas, to which there is a suburban nearness of the Cirtense colony, in which city then especially the attacks of persecution were swelling as waves of the age by blind frenzy of pagans and by military services, and the rage of the hostile devil was gaping with greedy jaws for testing the faith of the just. Whence Marianus and Iacobus, most blessed martyrs, most certainly held the desired signs of divine condescension in themselves, who, led down in that region in which the storm of persecution was raging more turbulently, with the hour now ripening, understood their steps directed, with Christ steering, to the very place of the crown. For the frenzy of the bloody and blinded governor was seeking all the beloved of God through military hands with hostile and attacking minds. Nor was the insanity of cruelty exercised against these alone, who in earlier persecutions unshaken lived freely to God, but the devil was extending his insatiable hand also against those whom, long since removed into exiles, although not yet in blood, already in mind martyrs, the fierce madness of the governor had crowned.
pass_b_english: For we were journeying together into Numidia, as we had always done before, setting out on the road in one allied and equal company, a road that was bringing us to the long-desired service of faith and devotion, while it was already bringing them to heaven. And we had come to the place called Muguas, which stands in suburban closeness to the colony of Cirta, a city in which at that time especially the assaults of persecution were swelling like the waves of the world through the blind frenzy of the pagans and through the work of soldiers, and the raging of the assailing devil stood gaping with greedy jaws to test the faith of the righteous.

From this the most blessed martyrs Marian and James most surely received the long-desired signs of divine favor resting upon them, for when they were brought into the very district where the storm of persecution was raging most fiercely, they understood, as the hour was now ripening, that their footsteps were directed under Christ's guidance to the very place of the crown. For the frenzy of the bloodstained and blinded governor was hunting down all God's beloved through soldiers' hands with hostile and assailing intent. Nor was the madness of cruelty vented upon those alone who had stood unshaken through earlier persecutions and lived freely for God, but the devil was stretching his insatiable hand against those also whom the governor's fierce madness had already crowned, though not yet in blood, already martyrs in resolve, after they had long since been sent away into exile.

choices.english: longed-for service of faith and devotion
choices.why: obsequium with genitives denotes dutiful performance owed to faith, and the road leads the living confessors to continued service rather than yet to death
mente contrasts with sanguine in the same clause, so it marks inward readiness rather than location or thought alone
rejected: martyrs in mind in a vague sense
martyrs by intention as a legal fiction
